who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor, host round 2 piece "surface image" second pass, port-memo-1113
what: Listing which variable an `env!`/`option_env!` call reads needs the expander's own argument parse, which is private to hir-expand's fn_macro.rs; the only public record of what was read is a log of what ran (`Files::env_read`), which the late list must never be built from. hir-def had to call a new hir-expand method (`EagerExpander::env_var_read`) outside its lane's files.
cost: a quarter hour finding the parse and writing the method for another lane to add
cause: a builtin macro's reads are worked out inside its expansion and only logged, never exposed as a function of the call
class: what an expansion reads known only as a side effect of running it, not as a typed function of the call
prevention: each eager builtin exposes its reads as a pure function of the call (`reads(db, call, arg) -> Late`) used by both its expansion and every list of late inputs, so the two cannot differ
workaround: `EagerExpander::env_var_read` in hir-expand, using the same `args` parse as the expansion
fix: listed in the lane report for the main agent (hir-expand is not this lane's file)
